title: Better Retrievers, Worse Labels: How Incomplete Relevance Judgments Distort Abstention Evaluation in Conversational RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.40966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conversational RAG benchmarks such as MTRAG and RETECO evaluate retrieval and generation end to end: each system answers from its own retrieval, so abstention must be scored against whether each retrieved context is sufficient. A convenient shortcut reads sufficiency off the relevance judgments and treats a context without gold documents as unanswerable. We re-run the official baselines exactly and test this shortcut on RECOR (RETECO track~2) with four retrievers (nDCG@10 from .18 to .59) and three Qwen3 readers. Two open LLM judges and a panel of four small open models label each context by content, and a model of another family audits 250 contexts blind, with adjudication. The stronger the retriever, the larger the share of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer (28\% to 72\%) and the lower the shortcut's precision (.68 to .10; .70 to .21 under the audit). A reader agrees: Qwen3-4B answers 62--67\% of these false misses correct

translated_title: 更好的检索器，更差的标签：不完整的相关性判断如何扭曲对话式RAG中的弃答评估
translated_abstract: 诸如MTRAG和RETECO等对话式RAG基准端到端地评估检索与生成：每个系统基于自己的检索结果进行回答，因此弃答行为必须根据每个检索到的上下文是否充分来评分。一种方便的捷径是直接从相关性判断中读取充分性，并将没有黄金文档的上下文视为无法回答。我们精确地重新运行了官方基线，并在RECOR（RETECO赛道2）上使用四个检索器（nDCG@10从0.18到0.59）和三个Qwen3阅读器测试了这一捷径。两个开源LLM评判器和一组由四个小型开源模型组成的评审团根据内容为每个上下文打标签，并由另一系列模型对250个上下文进行盲审与裁决。结果显示：检索器越强，没有黄金文档但实际仍包含答案的上下文比例越大（从28%到72%），而这种捷径的精确率越低（从0.68降至0.10；在盲审下为0.70到0.21）。阅读器模型也印证了这一点：Qwen3-4B能够正确回答这些“假性未命中”上下文中的62%至67%。
tldr: 该论文揭示，在对话式RAG评估中，“无黄金文档即不可回答”的捷径会因相关性判断不完整而严重失真——检索器越强，被遗漏但实际含答案的上下文比例越高（28%至72%），导致该捷径的精确率从0.68骤降至0.10。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the common shortcut of treating contexts without gold documents as unanswerable severely distorts abstention evaluation in conversational RAG—stronger retrievers yield a higher share (28%–72%) of no-gold contexts that still contain the answer, causing the shortcut's precision to drop from .68 to .10.
